evidence.section: 5.2. Micropillar test for yield stress analysis in the machined surface
evidence.quote: Compared to bulk counterparts the yield strengths of micropillars near machined surface were increased by 144% and 120% within Alloy A under normal cutting and aggressive cutting respectively, while Alloy B was increased only 110 % and 85% correspondingly.

conflicts.description: SCE values for Alloy A under aggressive cutting are stated to be much lower than Alloy B in the text, but no numerical values are given; qualitative comparison only is retained.
